test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends I, J, K, L and M are sitting in a row facing north. Only I is seated between L and M. K is seated 2ⁿd from the left end and is not an immediate neighbour of M. Where is J seated?
solution:
The sitting arrangement here is:

1. Only I is seated between L and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/437d78e7ec3d8f656836d37ac63dd026f599568569e54bed92604e48670f171e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/926504b9614d676f1000abff8a9181b545f6145a0c96712ec0c3e00bf05777ad.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1728b1b4f0a4c8b9e6988d9baf05f77ddaecd0aebe5ebda84d0af26da8ad0f6.png] 

2. K is seated 2nd from the left end and is not an immediate neighbour of M. 

Here, case 1 and 3 will be eliminated because there is no space left at 2nd position from the left. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bbc825f757fa190bd12119421575bd7e7e434d0903c69b783caa59f8469dc03.png] 

3. Seating arrangement of J: After arranging everyone, only the extreme left hand is vacant, thus **J will be seated at the extreme left end.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0b40ad9b7282dd676921531b05e5e5791cc555c92b567807ea38cf56bb4e0fe.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**.
